name: Tinker shots use their recorded cast times without an extra ranged windup (#4112)
contract: Scrap Shot 500549 uses SpellCastTimes 19 (2500 ms); Rocket Launcher 500235 uses SpellCastTimes 14 (3000 ms), matching the reported tooltips. Both have USES_RANGED_SLOT, which otherwise adds 500 ms in CalcCastTime before haste and spell modifiers. Native players without talent purchases must read those recorded times at level 6 and for the highest ranks at level 60. The ordinary Hunter Steady Shot 34120 must retain its 2000 + 500 ms calculation, and the zero-cast-time Gatling Gun channel 500213 must still start immediately. These are native cast-time observations, not rendered client cast bars; the unnamed Starcaller attacks in the follow-up report are outside this selection.
